Mina: Quick one! Share a one-line childhood memory and one tiny song (<=2:00) that matches the vibe. No long essays, please. :sun_with_face:
Joe: Memory: "Rode a squeaky red bike until the chain fell off on Mrs. Patel's lawn." Song: Dinosaur Jr.  short live jam (fast and scrappy).
Priya: Memory: "We judged the best fort-building contest with flashlights and cold pizza." Song: The Go-Betweens  tiny jangly thing (under 2). :tent:
Omar: Memory: "My dad hums the same grocery-list melody when he's worried." Song: Jonathan Richman  short, pure and goofy.
Zoe: Love these. Memory: "Found a library card with someone else's name and felt like I'd stolen a secret." Song: The Vaselines  blip pop that fits reading. :books:
Joe: Also adding a weird one: The Specials  short ska flip that makes me smile.
Mina: This is perfect. Can someone stitch a 7-song under-2 playlist? Bonus points for crossfades. :raised_hands:
Priya: @Mina I'll export to Spotify and keep transitions tight. Want a tiny ambient tail?
Mina: Yes please 15s ambient tail. Makes it feel like the room closes the book. :sparkles:
PlaylistBot: Playlist created  "Tiny-Tales & Tiny-Tacks"  https://open.spotify.com/playlist/tiny-tales-xyz789 (7 tracks + ambient tail).
Omar: Already crying at the last 15s loop. 10/10 would reread a library card again. :cry:
